scope: Headless functional VGA/VBE edge validation; no raster timing or complete VGA certification claim

blackbook.terms: Upstream Abrash book/source terms; no binaries bundled with PCEmu

comparisonRules: Native text: independent IBM CRTC/plane/font/DAC per-pixel oracle; QEMU text omits relevant panning rules.
Graphics: compare all pixels at six-bit DAC precision, normalize logical scanline duplication; no masked graphic regions.
Virtual-screen comparison uses origin (4,4) because QEMU truncates the byte start address to four-byte units.
DOSLIB requires 15 mode sections, zero WARN/ERROR entries and NORMAL EXIT; skipping timed pauses does not assert visual demos.
X-VESA reliability checks exact addressing-model strings and literal zero-error counters for BITS/BURST/MATRIX in 256 KiB.
Virtual geometry is deliberately bounded; X-VESA reports its larger-bound search UNTESTED.
Legacy-register availability prompts are accepted only when presented; reliability/graphics results must subsequently pass.
QEMU uses icount shift=7,align=off,sleep=off to accelerate guest delays; no throughput/retrace timing conclusions.
Unmodified third-party binaries live only in ignored build caches. Existing DOS parent is read-only; successful owned overlays removed.

indexedVBEOriginsAndPageFlips.oracle: Independent full-frame packed-pattern/DAC oracle executes ROM 4F07 set/get

Windows3.11.scope: Notepad save and exact DOS readback; private AUTOEXEC startup

Windows95.scope: Application arithmetic, clipboard, exact file persistence and guest-requested restart

remainingLimits: Not all 30 Abrash binaries, every interactive diagnostic or animated page flip were automated
